subject.title: [Bug]: Session stuck in permanent busy state after mid-turn gateway restart — no auto-recovery, only /new or /reset clears it

question: Should #92519 remain the standalone tracker for end-to-end busy-state recovery, be folded into #57425 after sibling slices land, or be split entirely across #90282 and #92270?
rationale: Current code has partial recovery, but the issue's user-visible success condition crosses restart recovery, final delivery hooks, and lane release; automation cannot safely choose that ownership boundary while related PRs remain open or closed unmerged.

options.title: Keep Standalone Until E2E Proof
options.body: Keep #92519 open as the focused acceptance target until final delivery and lane-release fixes land and a live restart proof shows follow-up messages work without `/new` or `/reset`.

options.title: Fold Into #57425 Umbrella
options.body: Move the remaining behavior under the broader graceful-restart umbrella once narrower delivery and lane-release issues are merged or explicitly scoped out.

options.title: Split Across Sibling Issues
options.body: Close this only after maintainers decide #90282 and #92270 fully own all remaining user-visible failure modes and add explicit acceptance criteria there.

recommendation.title: Keep Standalone Until E2E Proof
recommendation.body: Keep #92519 open as the focused acceptance target until final delivery and lane-release fixes land and a live restart proof shows follow-up messages work without `/new` or `/reset`.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided member scoping on the broader graceful-restart umbrella that this issue may fold into, while the narrower code owners remain represented in likelyOwners.
